constructionLineage.root: the pushed commit containing this authorization record

objective: v0.6 multi-node sessions per docs/roadmap.md section 0.6: concurrent connections to multiple selected nodes, clear target scope in the UI, per-node session isolation, no implicit broadcast execution

must: RFC-first design record for multi-node sessions and target scoping (RFC-0013) before product construction
concurrent connections to multiple selected nodes across direct and reverse transports
clear and unambiguous target scope in the UI
strict per-node session and cookie isolation
strict prohibition against implicit broadcast execution or silent failover
candidate-freeze rule compliance and fresh candidate-bound evidence for the v0.6 release candidate
operator documentation (SOP) and architecture reference updates for multi-node sessions
should: first-class Devices and Nodes view in the authenticated operator surface per UX reference recommendations
per-node session visibility and connection state tracking
graceful handling of concurrent node disconnects or reachability degradation
outOfScope: fleet workflows and scheduled multi-node command execution (roadmap 0.7)
a new route authority system beyond RFC-0010
a new selector system beyond RFC-0011
a new DSH compatibility profile without a designed RFC and compliance with the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

allowedPathRules: package.json: dependency changes require recorded justification
forbiddenActions: reopening or rewriting the accepted v0.5 closure lineage or its attestation
cherry-picking quarantined historical constructions into v0.6
product construction before RFC-0013 and Stage 0 Gate A approval is recorded
changing the DSH baseline outside the DSH baseline promotion policy
tag or release creation/mutation without separate authorization

evidenceRequirements.candidateFreezeRule: exactly one frozen candidate per evidence round; once frozen, later phases produce only qualification/evidence; a real problem means a new candidate and fresh candidate-bound evidence
evidenceRequirements.multiNodeSessionMatrixRequired: a multi-node session acceptance matrix must be defined in RFC-0013 and mechanically enforced before the v0.6 mounted evidence run
evidenceRequirements.closureRule: one evidence-only closure, direct child of the frozen candidate, attestation must not reference its own closure SHA
